PDF text extraction; layout and embedded images are not reproduced.

[Source page 1]

             COOPERATION and EXHIBITION CONFIRMATION 2025

                                between

 PhD student Asker Bryld Staunæs, Department of Communication and Culture, Aarhus
                 University [████]

                                   og

                                Kunsthal Aarhus


Kunsthal Aarhus has the pleasure to confirm a cooperation agreement with PhD student Asker
Bryld Staunæs and the Department of Communication and Culture, Aarhus University [████]


It is agreed that:
       Kunsthal Aarhus and Asker Bryld Staunæs will arrange an exhibition at the Kunsthal in the spring
       2025 about synthetic parties. Dates and details will be agreed early 2024.
       Asker may possibly contact an external curator who can assist with the exhibition.
       The Kunsthal will in 2024 take the initiative to find funding for the exhibition (in cooperation with
        Asker).
